race.comment: JENNI YOU THINK (10) has been knocking on the door, consistently running into the minor money including last start at Kilmore when getting too far back from a very wide gate and rattling into second. Turns around quickly here, will be rock hard fit and can atone. COOLY (6) presents third up and ready to peak. Both runs back have been sound. 8 lengths off Shadhavar at Flemington is a solid form considering she went and won the G1 Orr Stakes next time out. COCO JEN (5) made sharp improvement second up at Cranbourne last week behind Jenni Multabella. Should be peaking now and can win. OAK BEACH (4) was fair first up here behind the airborne Fundamental Nature, fitter for that and comes back a notch. BON FETE (11) has been okay in two runs this time in and should be at peak fitness now with Williams taking over.
